author: Glass Reflection
description:
The trend of anime endings heading straight to the cinema is officially becoming the new normal, and after looking at the recent announcements, I had to sit down and figure out what this means for us.

In this discussion, I’m talking about the industry's shift toward theatrical finales for massive shows like Kaiju No. 8, Demon Slayer, and Haikyuu. For the major series covered, I give you a quick, under-a-minute breakdown of the three categories of anime films wrapped up within a larger discussion of why studios are making this shift and how the community is responding to the wait times. Whether you're curious if the breathtaking animation of Infinity Castle justifies the cinema price, looking at the accessibility nightmare for international fans, or wondering why the Girls und Panzer finale is taking almost a decade, this is your guide to the pros, cons, and reality of anime in theaters.
